### Thinking Higher
Author: Rachel Olsen
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-mar-10-2010-11627303.html
Passage: Colossians 3:2
Points:
- Believers often encounter warnings against being too heavenly minded, but Scripture directly urges us to set our minds above.
- Meditating on eternity and our union with Christ is an act of worship that fuels true hope.
- A heavenly perspective is not an escape, but a stimulant toward love, zeal, and active obedience on earth.
- Fixing attention on temporal affairs fosters self-absorption, whereas an eternal view realigns our daily focus with Christ.
- Understanding our true destiny in heaven leads us to live now by the values of God's kingdom.

### Goods vs. God
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-feb-28-2015.html
Passage: Colossians 3:2
Points:
- Believers face perpetual cultural temptation to substitute temporal possessions for eternal realities.
- Earthly goods must never be allowed to crowd out our attention to the things above.
- Our daily ambition should center on serving God and ministering His Word rather than impressing people.
- Material acquisitions can never provide lasting peace, happiness, or spiritual resolution.
- Keeping our minds fixed on Christ helps cultivate financial discipline and protects our hearts from covetousness.

### Power Point - Jan. 10, 2007
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-jan-10-2007-1462654.html
Passage: Colossians 3:2
Points:
- The believer's greatest day is coming home to see Jesus face to face.
- God places a healthy longing for heaven into the heart of every Christian.
- Desiring eternity transforms our present earthly conduct and daily priorities.
- Cultivating pure, holy affections crowds out corrupt and harmful earthly desires.
- Fixing our minds on Christ and His work ensures we are ready for eternity.
